name: neosian-cache
description: Maintain an already-warm conversation cache while idle, with visible receipts and no automatic cold rebuilds.

enabled.title: Keep warm while idle
enabled.description: Maintain an observed one-hour cache until the session closes. Expired or uncertain caches wait for your next message.

allowApi.title: Allow usage-billed sessions
allowApi.description: Also allow maintenance without subscription usage indicators, when a one-hour cache is observed. Requests use your account's normal billing.
